note: ADR-0011 §3.2 bars for a dynamics processor; class B as §3.5 lists the mix bus (the oversampled colour stage is part 2). Static curve against the Giannoulis et al. gain computer with DC levels at each stepped ratio; manual attack and release are the 63 % times of the gain change in dB from step tests; auto release is held to its fast path's time after a 10 ms overload and its slow path's after 4 s. brain/research/native-mixbus-n2.md has the figures. Colour (part 2): the line transformer of common/dsp at the oversampled rate; its harmonics 2-9 at 1 kHz and 40 Hz (-12 dBFS) against the same model driven by an ideal oversampled sine (colour.harmonic_db, above colour.floor_dbc); LF first; sag; 0 % is the compressor delayed, to the bit; aliasing on tones 1-19 kHz at the nominal -18 dBFS per quality (-70 eco, -90 standard and high, ADR-0011 3.2), hotter levels reported. CPU (3.5, class B): eco is held to the class with colour at 0 and at 100 % on the programme and programme +12 dB; standard and high are reported. p999_kernels is eco colour 100 %, programme +12 dB, in reference kernels (92.7 us over 83.8 us on a loaded laptop, --cpu-calibrate), held to x1.15.
